method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P, Nasdaq futures inch up ahead of Warsh's debut
Equities.reason: Near-term market tone modestly positive (futures up) despite Fed leadership change; captures market reaction ahead of Kevin Warsh's first meeting — relevant to broad equity sentiment but not a decisive regime shift.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Welcome to the Warsh era
Equities.reason: Macro/regime piece flagging a Fed leadership shift toward a potentially hawkish stance — important negative impulse for broad risk assets and valuation multiples, hence higher relevance and negative direction.

Equities.title: Nasdaq Futures Rising as Iran Peace Deal Boosts the Market Ahead of Fed Decision
Equities.reason: Geopolitical de-escalation (Iran peace deal) is a clear risk-on catalyst that lifts futures and market breadth ahead of the Fed; large market-moving theme with high relevance to equity risk sentiment.

Equities.title: US asset managers file for first ETFs targeting Wall Street's new obsession, AI and the 'MANGOS'
Equities.reason: Structural market narrative: AI leadership and index/ETF productization amplify flows into a concentrated group of winners (MANGOS). High relevance because this reinforces a dominant regime-driving factor for equities.

Equities.title: China Stock Gauge Sinks as Traders Favor AI Winners Elsewhere
Equities.reason: Highlights regional rotation into AI winners and away from broad China exposure — supports the cross-market narrative of AI-led outperformance and concentration of equity flows.

Equities.title: Databricks sales growth tops 80%, but margin are shrinking from swarm of AI agents
Equities.summary: Databricks is seeing higher growth as AI agents assist with data analysis, but all that activity is significantly increasing costs.
Equities.reason: Company-level datapoint that flags a common sector risk: rapid AI-driven revenue growth paired with margin pressure from higher cloud/compute costs — a modest negative signal for profitability expectations across cloud/AI names.

Equities.title: Technical factors are adding fuel to SpaceX's meme stock fire
Equities.summary: Options, leveraged ETFs and index arbitrage are likely boosting the stock ahead of its inclusion in some benchmark stock indexes.
Equities.reason: Large single-stock flow dynamics (options, ETFs, index inclusion) are materially reshaping trading behavior and broader market headlines; positive for near-term risk appetite and thematic concentration despite idiosyncratic risks.

Equities.title: Hong Kong Deals Spring to Life With Over $4 Billion of Listings
Equities.reason: Stronger IPO activity in Hong Kong signals improved risk appetite and capital markets health in Asia — positive for regional equity issuance and secondary-market liquidity.

Equities.title: Barclays lifts STOXX 600 annual target to 670
Equities.reason: Sell-side higher target for European benchmark is a modestly bullish signal for regional equities and reflects analyst optimism that supports market sentiment.

Rates.title: Oil slides on Iran supply hopes; bond yields pushed lower before Warsh debut
Rates.reason: Headline notes oil slump and explicitly says bond yields were pushed lower — direct, high-relevance signal of bond rally/near-term downward pressure on yields ahead of the Fed transition.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve set to hold interest rates in Warsh's debut as chair
Rates.summary: The United States (US) Federal Reserve (Fed) announces its interest rate decision on Wednesday, another pivotal meeting for markets to gauge the stance of policymakers and new Chair Kevin Warsh as energy prices retreat after the United States and Iran reached
Rates.reason: Fed expected to hold rates and falling energy reduces near-term inflation upside — modestly supportive for bonds (yields lower) but not decisive until guidance/dots.

Rates.title: Fed Chair Warsh expected to withhold 'dot' from central bank's interest rate outlook
Rates.summary: The central bank's Federal Open Market Committee is set to release its quarterly update of where individual officials expect interest rates to head.
Rates.reason: Withholding the dot plot reduces clarity on the Fed's path and can preserve 'higher-for-longer' uncertainty, a modest negative for bond prices (upward pressure on yields).

Rates.title: Bond Rally Fails to Allay Higher-for-Longer Global Rates Threat
Rates.reason: Headline frames the dominant macro narrative as higher-for-longer rates despite a rally — large negative for bonds (sustained upside pressure on yields) and high relevance.

Rates.title: Bond Options Traders Split on Fed Rate Path as Warsh Era Begins
Rates.reason: Market positioning shows a split on Fed path, implying elevated uncertainty/volatility for rates — modestly negative for bond prices because it supports a higher-for-longer risk premium.

Rates.title: The AI Boom’s Hunt for Cash Hits a New Corner of the Bond Market
Rates.reason: Corporate/sector-driven demand for short-term cash instruments (driven by AI-related capital needs) implies incremental bid for certain parts of the bond curve — supportive for bond prices (lower yields) in those pockets.

Rates.title: Plan for the Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds
Rates.reason: BOJ outright purchase plans are direct, high-relevance support for JGBs — mechanically supportive for bond prices (lower yields) in Japan and relevant to global rates via risk premia.

Rates.title: New data release: ECB wage tracker points to stable negotiated wage pressures in 2026
Rates.reason: ECB wage tracker showing stable negotiated wage pressures reduces upside inflation risk in the euro area — moderately positive for European bonds (downward pressure on yields).

Rates.title: UK stocks edge lower as investors assess inflation before BoE decision
Rates.reason: Market caution ahead of BoE decision and inflation data signals uncertainty for gilt yields; slight negative tilt as investors price potential for policy tightening or hawkish surprises.

Rates.title: UK inflation holds steady at 2.8% in May
Rates.summary: The Bank of England is due to update its monetary policy on Thursday.
Rates.reason: Steady inflation (moderating/stable rather than accelerating) reduces immediate upside surprise risk and is mildly supportive for gilts (lower yields) ahead of the BoE decision.

Rates.title: Middle East peace deal could herald oil glut next year, says IEA
Rates.summary: ‘Gradual’ return of flows will give way to sharp rise in production, outstripping forecasts for increased demand
Rates.reason: IEA view of a prospective oil glut implies lower future energy-driven inflation — a notable positive for global bond markets (downward pressure on yields) via reduced inflation risk.

FX.title: United States Dollar: Rate-driven support into FOMC – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that the Dollar is firming ahead of the FOMC as iFlow data show it increasingly driven by rate expectations rather than safe-haven demand. Clients are net sellers of the Canadian Dollar and Australian Dollar, while some North Asian currenc
FX.reason: Direct FX-native note that the Dollar is being driven by rate expectations ahead of the FOMC (iFlow data). Strong, broad USD-support signal — negative for non-USD pairs.

FX.title: US Dollar: Cyclical bullishness takes over – ING
FX.summary: ING strategists highlight that cyclical drivers have reasserted themselves in FX, underpinning a stronger Dollar over the coming months. They argue that these cyclical factors will keep the Dollar bid, delaying any meaningful downturn.
FX.reason: Macro FX view arguing for sustained USD strength on cyclical drivers — reinforces dominant Dollar-bull narrative into policy events.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) Price Forecast: Consolidates near 99.50 ahead of Fed
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, consolidates in a narrow band around mid-99.00s through the first half of the European session on Wednesday as traders opt to wait for the outcome of a two-day FOMC meeting.
FX.reason: DXY consolidation ahead of FOMC — indicates dollar bid / positioning into Fed. Market-event-driven, modest immediate impact but high relevance to USD pairs.

FX.title: ECB policymaker Simkus: Sees at least one more rate hike to cap inflation expectations
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker, Gediminas Šimkus, crossed the wires during the early European session on Wednesday, saying there's still enough upside risk for inflation to justify additional policy tightening.
FX.reason: Direct ECB hawkish signal — supportive for EUR vs USD. Important for EURUSD but must be viewed against strong Fed-driven Dollar backdrop.

FX.title: Euro: ECB pipeline inflation keeps hikes priced – Deutsche Bank
FX.summary: Deutsche Bank comments that despite recent declines in Oil and Euro inflation swaps, ECB chief economist Philip Lane warns that earlier energy shocks will still feed through to prices.
FX.reason: DB note that ECB hikes remain priced because of pipeline effects — incremental EUR support but partially priced into markets.

FX.title: Euro: Euro struggles on hawkish ECB pricing – ING
FX.summary: ING’s FX team notes that a rate hike by the ECB is fully priced into EUR/USD, limiting upside for the Euro. They stress that even additional ECB hawkishness may not translate into Euro gains, as markets already discount tighter policy.
FX.reason: Counter-signal: hawkish ECB already priced, limiting EUR upside — reduces relevance of ECB hawks to near-term EURUSD strength.

FX.title: British Pound dips to weekly lows following soft UK inflation figures
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) extends losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with the GBP/USD pair hitting a weekly low of 1.3410 at the time of writing.
FX.reason: Soft UK inflation = weaker GBP vs USD; supports the prevailing Dollar-edge narrative and has direct pair-level transmission (GBPUSD).

FX.title: British Pound weakens below 215.00 vs JPY on softer UK inflation data, intervention fears
FX.summary: The GBP/JPY cross attracts heavy selling following the release of UK consumer inflation figures on Wednesday and, for now, seems to have snapped a three-day winning streak.
FX.reason: Non-USD cross flagged because of intervention fears — signals material GBP weakness and potential central-bank/market intervention risk; relevant to GBP liquidity and risk flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar stays pressured vs USD; holds above 0.7050 as traders await Fed decision
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's hawkish Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA)-inspired bounce and trades with a negative bias for the second consecutive day on Wednesday.
FX.reason: AUD under pressure into Fed — commodity-linked AUD sold into USD strength; clear cross-border flow into USD trades.

FX.title: 0.7000: Why the Australian Dollar is heading for deeper pullback after RBA broke its rate-hike spree
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) has entered a corrective phase, surrendering part of its recent gains against the US Dollar, after the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) opted to break its tightening cycle and hold its benchmark cash rate at 4.35%.
FX.reason: RBA pause reduces AUD carry appeal, supporting further AUD weakness vs USD — thematic for AUDUSD flows.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Holds gains above 1.4000, bullish bias persists despite overbought RSI
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair trades in positive territory around 1.4005 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Optimism surrounding the US-Iran peace agreement drags crude oil prices lower and weighs on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD).
FX.reason: USD strength vs CAD amid lower oil and risk-off/positioning into policy — direct USD/CAD transmission; supports broader USD bid.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as market caution emerges ahead of Fed policy decision
FX.summary: NZD/USD depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.5820 during the early European hours on Wednesday. The pair loses ground as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) struggles on market caution ahead of the Federal Reserve (Fed) pol
FX.reason: NZD weakening into Fed — cohort-level move among commodity/FX-sensitive pairs as traders position for US policy.

FX.title: PBOC Launches Tool to Boost Yuan Use by Other Central Banks
FX.reason: Policy tool to internationalise the yuan — medium-term positive pressure for CNY versus USD and a structural EM/FX consideration for reserve/cross-border flows.

FX.title: BOJ Keeps Market Steady With Yen Volatility at Lowest Since 2021
FX.reason: Low JPY volatility signals muted intervention/readiness and calmer yen flows — small supportive signal for JPY stability, limited immediate impact on USD crosses.

FX.title: Merz at G7: China’s currency undervalued by up to 30%
FX.reason: High-level political comment on CNY undervaluation implies potential for appreciation pressure or policy tension — relevant to CNY/USD dynamics and broader EMFX sentiment.

Commodities.title: Silver price remains under pressure as Fed decision, US-Iran truce shape outlook
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades around $69.85 on Wednesday at the time of writing, down 0.25% on the day. Traders remain cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) policy decision later in the day, which could provide fresh guidance on the outlook for US interest r
Commodities.reason: Near-term price weakness for silver tied to Fed uncertainty and easing geopolitical risk (US‑Iran truce) = downward pressure. Medium relevance as this is a short-term price narrative ahead of FOMC.

Commodities.title: Gold: Fed repricing and Iran peace deal – UOB
Commodities.summary: UOB Global Economics & Markets Research highlights that Gold advanced as expectations for another Fed hike this year eased following an interim US-Iran peace deal that pushed Oil and inflation expectations lower.
Commodities.reason: Macro-driven support for gold: Fed repricing (fewer hikes / lower rates) and lower oil/inflation expectations are bullish for bullion. High relevance because it links policy and geopolitical developments to gold demand.

Commodities.title: Oil: Price collapse reshapes Fed risk view – MUFG
Commodities.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny underlines that Brent Oil falling below USD 80 and a roughly 30% drop in crude over a month have significantly reduced perceived near-term inflation risks from energy.
Commodities.reason: Large, rapid Brent decline materially lowers near‑term inflation risk and reshapes macro/rate expectations — strongly negative for oil prices and commodity inflation impulse.

Commodities.title: Brent Oil: Peace framework drives declines – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid and colleagues note that Brent Oil has extended its decline as markets react to reports of a 14‑point US–Iran peace framework, including waivers for Iranian exports and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Peace framework/reopening of shipping lanes and export waivers directly increase supply/near‑term risk premium removal — clear negative for Brent with meaningful market relevance.

Commodities.title: From supply shock to oil glut: IEA flags scale of demand destruction caused by Iran war
Commodities.summary: The energy supply shock triggered by the Iran War has prompted the IEA to slash its global oil demand forecast.
Commodities.reason: IEA downward revision to demand is a direct, high‑relevance negative for oil prices — complements the peace/supply‑reopening narrative and adds substantive fundamental downside.

Commodities.title: Three Iranian tankers exit U.S. blockade for first time in months as shipowners eye Hormuz in 'wary disbelief'
Commodities.summary: At least three Iranian tankers carrying nearly five million barrels of crude oil have exited the U.S. Navy blockade.
Commodities.reason: Renewed Iranian flows increase near‑term crude supply and weigh on oil prices. Relevant as concrete supply arrivals but narrower in scope than macro forecasts.

Commodities.title: Central banks are bringing gold reserves home as geopolitical risks rise
Commodities.summary: Central banks expect gold reserves to rise and more are storing bullion at home amid geopolitical and currency risks.
Commodities.reason: Structural/official demand and repatriation trends support gold as a reserve asset — medium‑high relevance for longer‑term bullion fundamentals and risk insurance narrative.

Commodities.title: Ranked: The world’s top Silver producers
Commodities.summary: Half of the world’s mined Silver comes from only three countries: Mexico, Peru and China. In a market facing running structural deficits, the concentration in only a few countries leaves it subject to vulnerability in case there is any disruption in any of the
Commodities.reason: Concentrated supply and structural deficits are supportive for silver prices over time. Useful supply‑side context with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Japan’s Humble 10-Yen Coin Now Worth 10.4 Yen On AI Copper Rally
Commodities.reason: AI-driven demand narrative lifting copper (industrial metals) is supportive for copper prices and reflects cyclical/structural demand upside. Medium relevance as it signals broader metals appetite beyond precious metals.

Commodities.title: The long way back from the Iran energy shock
Commodities.summary: Oil production facilities and markets will take months or years to work through consequences of Strait of Hormuz closure
Commodities.reason: Longer‑term risk that supply infrastructure recovery is slow supports elevated structural oil risk premium. Included as a lower‑relevance counterpoint to near‑term peace/demand headlines.

Crypto.title: State Street targets stablecoin reserve boom with new money market fund

Crypto.title: Hyperliquid, Uniswap and Worldcoin buck crypto slump as traders chase AI, DeFi trends
Crypto.reason: Reinforces a rotation toward AI/DeFi-themed tokens, indicating thematic flows into specific crypto sectors (supportive for those tokens and risk-on alt dynamics).

Crypto.title: Crypto PAC's $12 million Senate candidate, Barry Moore, wins Alabama GOP primary
Crypto.reason: Political victory financed by crypto-aligned PACs signals continued political engagement and potential legislative tailwinds, but impact is localized and uncertain (low relevance).
